summary: Sherri Ahlbrandt, 54, of Littleton, disappeared while hiking in the Oh Be Joyful/Daisy Pass area; four-day search of 250+ square miles by ~50 SAR volunteers, search dogs and helicopters; remains found October 29 near Middle Anthracite Creek
location: Oh Be Joyful/Daisy Pass area, Gunnison National Forest
responding_agency: Crested Butte Search & Rescue; Western State Colorado University Search & Rescue; Crested Butte Fire Protection District; U.S. Army Chinook; statewide SAR volunteers
notes: Largest local SAR operation in years; search area covered 250+ square miles of steep, cliffed terrain. A hunter delivered her waist pack to police October 23, prompting the October 29 recovery operation. Remains identified by dental records; medical examiner classified death as undetermined and accidental. Alpine Rescue Team assisted Crested Butte SAR in this search (Alpine 2014 annual mission summary, mission 14-79, paged 08/15/14). 10/29 recovery op detail (CBN 2014/10): 10-person CBSAR + WSCU SAR team departed Erickson Springs Trailhead (CR 12); remains located ~12:45 near Middle Anthracite Creek, close to where a hunter-delivered waist pack was found. Merged 2026-09-14 (run 414): CBN 2014-10-01 "search still being made" account — helicopter used Sept 25-26, search scaled back rather than called off.
